attribution: Exclusive cProfile time of Python code objects in the actual frozen source. Each code object is charged once per phase. Direct native calls, guard and qualification methods, non-owned source, external and unresolved time carry zero editable credit.
uncertainty: Use the smaller measured saving across both seeds. Charge the absolute span of measured site durations as noise. Exact-site prior rejections reduce estimated savings in proportion to their count.
decision: Rank all supported owned methods and compare with retaining the incumbent. Only authorize a code order when the 25% saving still clears the complete cold-work gate and noise, the repeated workload gains after warm work, and the six-pair experiment's measured cost can be repaid within the 256-start sensitivity horizon. The 50% scenario can prioritize additional targeted measurement; insufficient optimistic headroom defers. None of these forecasts qualifies code.
cost: Report actual broker seconds, current lease hourly price, discovery time, A/A, six paired arms and two factual-first pairs. Do not impute production restart demand from test traffic.
